decisions.reason: As a multi-model product line close to the core formwork business that survived the earlier portfolio review, it likely meets or is near aspiration levels and remains worth keeping despite some uncertainty from its later low visibility.

Because it supports the firm's automation strategy and integrated factory offering, management would still keep it, although its modest website prominence suggests somewhat greater risk if results have remained below aspirations.

This dedicated-page formwork strip line fits the established modular portfolio well, so a growing Mittelstand machinery firm with R&D capabilities would likely retain it unless performance clearly deteriorates.

This is still the most vulnerable survivor because it appears to be a narrower, lower-prominence component, but its close relatedness to the core magnetic formwork business and the firm's available slack make retention slightly more likely than withdrawal.
